name: revenue-health-analyzer
description: Portfolio-level revenue retention diagnostic for Zoho Billing. Computes Net Revenue Retention and bands it against industry norms, pulls cohort retention curves, renders a starting-MRR-to-ending-MRR waterfall (expansion / contraction / churn), and surfaces the 30/60/90-day renewal cliff in dollars. Outputs a Red/Yellow/Green retention call plus a propose-only short-list of at-risk renewals worth attention. Read-only; no subscription changes are written back.
